title: Cragspine's Regrowing Ridge
story: Cragspine the Quarry Beast blocks the mountain road with the stone spikes along his back, and every spike Mr 6 knocks off makes two smaller ones grow back — except the very last strike, which shatters the whole ridge. Everyone else charged in swinging and made things worse. Mr 6 sits on a boulder and counts first.
question: Cragspine starts with 5 spikes. Each strike removes 1 spike but grows 2 new ones back. After 9 strikes, how many spikes are on his ridge?
hint: Each strike takes 1 away and adds 2 — so what is the net change per strike?
victory: Mr 6 announced the exact count out loud, and Cragspine — who had never once been counted correctly — laughed so hard his whole ridge crumbled and the road opened.
imagePrompt: A hulking grey quarry beast with a jagged ridge of stone spikes blocking a mountain road, a small numeral-six knight seated calmly on a boulder tallying marks in chalk, dusty afternoon light.
